newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Steam participation in pool to rise.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Steam participation in pool to rise.

text.p: Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Co said Thursday it is increasing its participation in the Industrial Risk Insurers pool, adding about $20 million to $25 million in revenue in 1997.
The company said it was increasing its participation to 23.5 percent from 14 percent, effective December 1.

Industrial Risk Insurers is a Hartford-based insurance pool that provides property insurance for large manufacturing, processing and industrial businesses that have invested in protection against loss.
